item: the machine record names the YAML loader in use (versions.yaml_loader); item 47 (R429) withdrawn by R432
summary: versions.yaml_loader (CSafeLoader or SafeLoader, read from src.utils.safe_yaml.YAML_LOADER without parsing, null if unreadable) inside the 10,000 B machine-record bound; both values and the null are tested. The kv_store half of C13 (raise KvReadError beside a non-empty -wal, R429) was built, read by an independent reviewer and WITHDRAWN before merge (R432): a read-only open reads the wal, so the premise was false, and the change made init_db fail on a store that predates app_state. R256's wait stands. Lesson in lessons.d. Item 27 (R431) stays a proposal.
